population: Nulliparous, first trimester
comparison_and_duration: Cocoa butter lotion vs vehicle, daily until delivery
findings: New striae at postpartum assessment: 45.1% vs 48.8%, P=.730.
limitations: 35 did not complete. Wide uncertainty remains; vehicle may moisturize.

population: Pregnant participants from 16 weeks
comparison_and_duration: Cocoa butter cream vs placebo cream through delivery
findings: New striae: 44% vs 55%, P=.09.
limitations: 150 allocated per arm. Verify analyzed denominators before converting percentages to counts.

population: Pregnant participants
comparison_and_duration: Centella-containing combination cream vs vehicle
findings: New striae in 14 treated (34%) and 22 controls (56%).
limitations: Multiple ingredients; small study and nonstandard severity score.

population: Pregnant participants with and without previous striae
comparison_and_duration: Multi-ingredient cream vs base cream
findings: Overall new striae: 37.6% vs 33.3%. In those without previous marks: 5.6% vs 35%.
limitations: Subgroup precision poor; do not substitute subgroup for overall outcome.

population: First pregnancy, single center in Turkey
comparison_and_duration: Almond oil plus massage vs oil alone vs usual care
findings: Striae frequencies were 20%, 38.8% and 41.2%, respectively.
limitations: Groups of 47, 48 and 46. Allocation and co-intervention limit causal attribution.

population: Women aged 35–55, cosmetic skin-aging study
comparison_and_duration: Branded bovine collagen peptides vs placebo, eight weeks
findings: Investigators reported improved hydration, elasticity and eye wrinkles.
limitations: Pregnancy and striae outcomes absent. Separate fibroblast experiment.
conflicts: An author reported industry-supported lectures and collagen-related patents.

population: People with existing striae
comparison_and_duration: Microneedling plus ascorbic acid vs fractional CO2 laser plus ascorbic acid
findings: Physician ratings and patient satisfaction favored the laser side.
limitations: Twenty-two people, not 44 independent participants. No untreated side.

population: Diastasis, 6–12 months postpartum
comparison_and_duration: Home abdominal exercises five days/week for 12 weeks vs no program
findings: Strength increased by 9 Nm; resting gap difference was 1 mm.
limitations: Gap assessed 2 cm above umbilicus. One protocol and population.

population: First 48 hours after cesarean at one Turkish hospital
comparison_and_duration: Abdominal binder vs control
findings: Lower reported incisional and uterine pain in binder group.
limitations: 64 completers per arm. Short follow-up, subjective outcomes.

population: Previously pregnant people seeking breast aesthetic surgery
comparison_and_duration: History of breastfeeding vs none
findings: Breastfeeding was not independently associated with ptosis. Fifty-four reported breastfeeding.
limitations: Selected surgical population, recall, possible residual confounding.

population: BMI ≥30 and unexplained infertility, nine US centers
comparison_and_duration: 16-week intensive weight-loss program vs increased activity before standardized infertility therapy
findings: Healthy live birth in 23/188 vs 29/191.
limitations: Intervention bundled diet, activity and medication. Primary analysis by allocation.
funding: NIH/NICHD and NCATS grants. Nutrisystem discounted food and Fitbit discounted trackers.
conflicts: Several authors disclosed external research or consulting relationships. See the report for individual declarations.

population: Pregnant participants in antenatal training study
comparison_and_duration: Supervised pelvic floor training vs usual care
findings: Leakage at 36 weeks: 48/148 vs 74/153. At three months postpartum: 29/148 vs 49/153.
limitations: Self-reported symptoms; keep follow-ups within one study.

population: First birth, training began 6–8 weeks postpartum
comparison_and_duration: Four months of pelvic floor training vs control; both taught a correct contraction
findings: No clear difference in prolapse after the intervention.
limitations: Broad interval. This outcome differs from prevention of leakage.

population: First birth, singleton cephalic at term, epidural, second stage
comparison_and_duration: Upright vs lying down position
findings: Spontaneous vaginal birth was more frequent in the lying-down group.
limitations: Open label; cannot generalize to birth without epidural.

population: Pregnancies randomized in Australia; 5,517 individuals
comparison_and_duration: Prenatal n-3 long-chain fatty acids vs control
findings: Birth before 34 weeks: 61/2734 vs 55/2752.
limitations: Unit is pregnancy. This later trial is independent of the earlier review search.
funding: Australian NHMRC and Thyne Reid Foundation; capsules donated by Croda UK and Efamol/Wassen UK.
conflicts: Suppliers reported to have no other trial role.

population: People planning pregnancy, primarily first occurrence rather than recurrence
comparison_and_duration: Periconceptional multivitamin vs trace elements
findings: Six neural-tube defects in controls and none in the vitamin group.
limitations: Known outcomes for 2,104 vitamin and 2,052 control pregnancies; combination formulation.

population: Previous neural-tube defect pregnancy
comparison_and_duration: Folic acid-containing groups vs groups without folic acid
findings: Six affected pregnancies vs 21.
limitations: Known-outcome completed pregnancies denominator; high baseline recurrence risk.

population: Early pregnancy with nausea and vomiting
comparison_and_duration: Ginger vs placebo over four days
findings: Nausea improved in 28/32 vs 10/35.
limitations: Short symptom trial, inadequate for rare fetal outcomes.

population: Pregnant before 16 weeks with nausea or vomiting
comparison_and_duration: Ginger vs vitamin B6 over three weeks
findings: Average nausea difference 0.2 with 90% CI −0.3 to 0.8.
limitations: Equivalence design and 90% interval; do not label it a 95% interval.

population: Pregnancy and postpartum timepoint groups
comparison_and_duration: Sixth and ninth months of pregnancy vs fourth month postpartum
findings: Higher fraction of resting hairs at four months postpartum.
limitations: Hair-cycle measurement differs from diagnosis of permanent hair loss.

population: Horizontal cesarean incision
comparison_and_duration: Silicone sheet vs paper tape on opposite halves for three months
findings: Patient-rated appearance favored silicone at 6 and 12 months; Vancouver Scar Scale differences were unclear.
limitations: Paired halves, different outcome instruments; clinical importance uncertain.

population: Dehisced perineal wound after vaginal birth
comparison_and_duration: Resuturing vs expectant management
findings: Early healing favored resuturing; by 6–8 weeks all but one wound had healed.
limitations: Few events and very wide interval; strong treatment preferences affected recruitment.

population: Uncomplicated pregnancy, enrolled before 12 weeks
comparison_and_duration: Compression stockings vs no stockings
findings: Leg symptoms improved in 7/27 vs 0/15; no convincing prevention of new visible varicose veins.
limitations: Small groups; reflux, appearance and comfort are different endpoints.

population: Pregnant participants measured again postpartum
comparison_and_duration: Within-person baseline vs postpartum foot measurements
findings: Mean arch height and rigidity fell and foot length increased.
limitations: Eleven discontinued. No randomized intervention or individual prediction.

population: Postpartum people at elevated depression risk
comparison_and_duration: Telephone peer support vs usual care
findings: EPDS score >12 at 12 weeks: 40/297 vs 78/315. Difference unclear at 24 weeks.
limitations: 612 assessed at 12 weeks. Screening threshold is not a diagnostic interview.

population: Periodontitis, randomized at 13–17 weeks
comparison_and_duration: Scaling/root planing before 21 weeks vs after birth
findings: Preterm births: 49/407 vs 52/405; periodontal measures improved.
limitations: Outcome includes losses as defined by investigators. Distinguish births from live births.

population: Periodontal disease in pregnancy, Western Australia
comparison_and_duration: Periodontal care starting near 20 weeks vs after pregnancy
findings: Preterm birth 9.7% vs 9.3%.
limitations: Single study across six obstetric sites, no clear obstetric benefit.

population: First pregnancy with breech presentation in late gestation
comparison_and_duration: Moxibustion plus usual care vs usual care
findings: Cephalic at birth: 98/130 vs 81/130.
limitations: External cephalic version after allocation occurred in 1 vs 24; interpretation depends on subsequent care.

population: Breech at 33+4 to 35+4 weeks
comparison_and_duration: Moxibustion and acupuncture vs inactive laser
findings: Breech at 37+2 weeks: 72.0% vs 63.4%.
limitations: Different comparator, combined therapy and earlier endpoint than S165.

population: Breech after week 33, stratified by parity
comparison_and_duration: Moxibustion vs no moxibustion
findings: No clear evidence of improved version in either parity group.
limitations: Parity strata must not be misread as treatment arms.

design: Prospective single-arm study with historical comparison
population: Pregnant sunscreen users in Morocco
comparison_and_duration: Broad-spectrum sunscreen, historical local estimate as comparator
findings: Five new cases of melasma among 185 completers.
limitations: Historical incidence is not a concurrent control; no causal risk reduction can be calculated.

population: Nulliparous pregnant participants in Tehran
comparison_and_duration: Olive oil on abdomen without massage vs no topical from enrollment to delivery
findings: No clear difference in incidence or severity of new marks.
limitations: Small unblinded comparison; baseline susceptibility and adherence matter.

population: People aged 18–40 attempting conception
comparison_and_duration: Connected urine hormone testing vs no test over up to two cycles
findings: Reported cumulative live birth 24.5% vs 17.5%.
limitations: Pregnancy outcomes available for 198 of 247 reported pregnancies. Commercial involvement and missing outcomes matter.
funding: SPD Development Company Limited, a subsidiary of SPD Swiss Precision Diagnostics.
conflicts: The follow-up report identifies four authors as company employees.

population: Pregnant with pelvic girdle pain and baseline pain ≥50/100
comparison_and_duration: Standard care plus acupuncture vs standard care plus nonpenetrating sham for eight weeks
findings: Median pain fell from 66 to 36 and 69 to 41, respectively; between-group P=.493.
limitations: Sham may have contextual effects; change within either arm does not isolate needling.

population: Exclusively breastfeeding at 6–8 weeks postpartum
comparison_and_duration: Structured aerobic training vs control over 12 weeks
findings: Fitness improved without a detectable difference in milk output, composition or infant weight gain.
limitations: Small selected group; cannot exclude rare harms or generalize to restricted energy intake.

population: First birth with early postpartum diastasis
comparison_and_duration: Exercise, binding or combined therapy vs no intervention
findings: At six months the authors estimated small to moderate standardized effects on body image in the binding groups and d=0.7 on trunk strength with combined therapy.
limitations: 16% attrition and small groups. Feasibility evidence, not a definitive cosmetic effect.

population: Infants following first-trimester topical retinoid exposure in prescription registers
comparison_and_duration: Topical retinoids vs unexposed; active comparator analyzed separately
findings: Major congenital malformations in 71/2172 exposed and 111404/3671023 unexposed. Adjusted RR 1.10, 95% CI 0.87 to 1.38.
limitations: Dispensing is not proof of use. Birth-based ascertainment can miss early pregnancy losses.
